legal_proceedings.description: The Pentagon's inspector general is investigating whether Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's aides were asked to delete Signal messages that may have shared sensitive military information with a reporter, focusing on the handling of information about March 15 airstrikes on Houthi targets in Yemen.

press_references.value: Pentagon halts trans enlistment, transition treatment for US troops

legal_proceedings.description: The Pentagon has halted transgender enlistment and transition treatment for US troops following a memo from Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, in response to President Donald Trump's executive order.

press_references.value: Pentagon secrets leaker Jack Teixeira set to be sentenced, could get up to 17 years in prison

legal_proceedings.description: Jack Teixeira, a Massachusetts Air National Guard member, is set to be sentenced for leaking classified military documents, violating the Espionage Act. Prosecutors seek a 17-year sentence, highlighting the severity of the breach.

press_references.value: Trump dashed Musk's secret Pentagon briefing on China

legal_proceedings.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth suspended two top Pentagon officials, Dan Caldwell and Darin Selnick, as part of an investigation into a leak about a planned top-secret briefing on China for Elon Musk. The investigation also involves leaks related to Panama Canal military plans, Red Sea operations, and intelligence collection in Ukraine.
